text: Resolved: the default is unbounded in the mathematical pair domain because production work is sorted O(n log n), not O(n squared). Existing explicitly supplied pair budgets remain honored with unchanged error precedence, preserving caller admission intent and compatibility. Algorithm uses strict tie groups and canonical operand reductions, extra precision on centered sums, and the biased energy::dcor estimator. Independent full-matrix, exhaustive ternary and large binary analytic regression cases passed JVM and JS at named 1e-12 tolerance; publication/runtime qualification remains work on bd-01M3DX8W40JSBV7MJCYZE2VQVQ, not closed by this design decision.
